composer.placeholder: What would you like to prepare? Type / for roles and skills…
composer.help: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
heading: What would you like to prepare today?
intro: Practice interviews, analyze job requirements, or organize interview materials.
workflow.replaceHint: Switching shows the new skill’s progress. Earlier messages remain available.
workflow.assist: Work on this step with the assistant
message.reference: Look up this message ID in observability
message.empty: This reply has no explanation. Ask about its evidence and the next step.
message.failed: This reply could not be completed.
report.invalid: This exam report link is invalid.
exam.hint: Confirm the scope, question count, and duration. After submission, question scores return here so you can discuss missed points.
practice.hint: Tell the assistant what you want to practice. After its explanation, start a practice exercise from that reply.
answer.hint: Answer independently, then ask the interviewer to review your words against the question. This feedback supports learning; formal competency evidence comes from independent exams.
answer.title: Question bank practice
search.title: Question bank search
search.matches: Found {count} matching question titles. Answer independently first, then use feedback to decide whether to read reference material.
search.empty: No matching question titles. Try a shorter keyword or clear it to browse the bank.
workflow.mock.prompt: Review the interview outline and what each stage assesses. Begin with a self-introduction and answer one question at a time.
workflow.prep.prompt: Confirm your target role and job description, then use the requirements to prioritize your study.
workflow.digest.prompt: Provide interview materials, identify topics to practice, and keep a record of missed questions.
workflow.project.prompt: Choose a project and use STAR to organize your experience around evidence of your own contributions.
workflow.review.prompt: Choose missed points from an exam report and practice questions that can verify your understanding.
workflow.boost.prompt: Use independent answers to identify gaps, plan targeted practice, and reassess your skills.
